I spent a lot of time in this game, more than seven thousand hours, and this is a great game that is definitely worth it. It's #1 the Military sandbox gender and is a treasure.

It's bad even with mods. 

Only reason I enjoy it is because I play it with some buddies, kind of the same way I enjoy D&D. Only in D&D I can build a game that works.

Here I can't.

Anyways- buggy, runs like ♥♥♥♥, clunky (Yes I know it's meant to be realistic, but then it's also super inconsistent - for a game running on a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ helicopter simulation engine, this game knows absolutely ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ about how helicopter physics or a helicopter in general works, and let's not even begin about airplanes. So why not take liberties with other things? Like how your stamina drains like a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ and most of the time you'd be stopping to regenerate stamina or just be super slow and have annoying "tired" effects on your screen at all times. Very enjoyable 10/10). It's straight up not fun. AI is ♥♥♥♥, no matter what the community tells you. I don't care how advanced they are *meant* to be, if they don't work then they don't ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ work. 

The maps are "ok" I guess, tho.

Also did I mention this game uses the most ridiculous control scheme? I played games with a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ of controls before, but I don't remember wanting to open my skull on a wall after playing ELITE: Dangerous.

Tl;dr just don't, go buy a better game. There are tons of better multiplayer games to play with your friends, including shooters. And if you're into that whole custom missions system, just...

Eh. Maybe when it's on sale and you have a whole bunch of friends who play it. Everything is fun with friends, I just know I had more fun playing ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ Fallout 76 with em than I had playing ArmA 3, and that game in it's entire existence almost has as many problems as.. um... any ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ living moment in ArmA3 from the very ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ menu loading screen.

Yikes.
